title: phrygilanthus suaveolens
intro: Phrygilanthus suaveolens, commonly known as the Night-Blooming Jasmine, is a species of flowering plant in the family Apocynaceae. This plant is valued for its fragrant flowers that bloom in the evening and have been used in traditional medicine for various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties. The health benefits of Phrygilanthus suaveolens include reducing stress and anxiety, improving sleep quality, and relieving symptoms of menopause. The bioactive constituents of this plant, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, contribute to its therapeutic actions such as sedation, calming the nervous system, and exhibiting antimicrobial activity.
